_readme: Landing 3:679 composition, from Figma (canvas 1400x1038; % of canvas). Each slot box is Figma's UNROTATED inner box, centred where Figma puts it, then rotated by rotateDeg. src = cut-outs re-rendered from the frame's own image fills (scripts/extract-landing-figma.mjs; reference-only screenshots). Change art direction here, not in code. Ornaments: Figma's vector 3:781, rotated per corner (3:701 TL 90, 3:941 TR 180, 3:781 BL 0, 3:861 BR -90). motion: every candy spins slowly and drifts nearer/farther (scale); per-slot spinSeconds/depthSeconds override the defaults. linksTo: candy slug the slot opens (null = not clickable). Cherry and raspberry aren't in the candy list, so they open Gott & Blandat (OPEN: confirm the mapping). motion.scroll*: scrolling stirs the candies: up to scrollTravel canvas px (nearest candy) and scrollSpinDeg extra spin, easing back home at scrollReturnPerSecond. mode: "universe" (doodle.mary-louise.com-style fly-through: scrolling flies you through a loop of every candy in depth; see universe) or "collage" (the Figma 3:679 still composition above, with spin/stir). universe: lanes = [x, y] px at depth 0 the items cycle through (doodle grid, kept out of the centre band: far candies converge on the vanishing point, which is the title); pieces = every candy hero plus (variants: true) every variant with an image, each linking to its candy page, interleaved by family; the set repeats `copies` times, stepZ px apart in depth (loop = items x stepZ); itemPx = size at depth 0 (each photo covers itemPx² x itemArea, so bars, bottles and skulls carry equal visual weight); perspectivePx = camera distance; fadeInPx = far fade-in; fadeOut*Z = where items fade as they pass the camera; farBlurPx from blurStartZ (Figma depth of field); spinDeg = turn while approaching; scrollSpeed = depth px per wheel px; ease = follow speed; driftPxPerSecond = idle float forward (0 = still); focusZ = depth a keyboard-focused candy is brought to. grid (mode "grid"): every candy hero (+ variants) as tiles grouped by candy, each linking to its page. hidePieces: photo srcs left off the landing (grid + universe) only; candy pages still show them. Owner asked (2026-10-19) to drop Daim, most black liquorice and the weakest photos. extraPieces: landing-only photos that aren't in the sheet (src, alt name, linksTo candy slug); shown with that candy's family (grid + universe). grid.intro: show the title + turquoise corner ornaments above the grid (false = just the candy grid; the title stays as a visually hidden h1). Owner, 2026-10-19: 'just focus on the candy grid'.
